title: model__prediction__generic__null-model
description: A dataset-agnostic null forecaster for the EPISERVE platform: repeat one statistic of the history window, with empirical q10/q90.

sections.title: Getting Started
sections.description: What the model does, how the container contract works, how to configure a run, and how to develop locally.

children.title: Overview
children.prompt: Explain the purpose of the null model, its flat forecast, and its role as the EPISERVE performance floor. Cite src/model.py:49-114 and fdo.json:119-127.

children.title: Container Contract
children.prompt: Describe /work/input/config.json + input.parquet -> /work/output/predictions.tsv, the exit-code rules, and the --check-config mode. Cite src/run.py:47-148 and Dockerfile:1-10.

children.title: Configuration
children.prompt: Document history_length, prediction_length, prediction_offset and statistic, their bounds and defaults, and the cross-field rule. Cite fdo.json:31-67 and src/config_schema.py:98-130.

children.title: Local Development

sections.title: Deep Dive
sections.description: The execution pipeline, series preparation, the forecast arithmetic, and card-driven validation.

children.title: Execution Pipeline

children.title: Time Axis and Target Handling

children.title: The Null Forecast
